thread:
Rae (Marketing): Heads up  final Snowcrest case write-up is ready for signoff. Need legal ok on one quote, PR embargo timing, and Sales to confirm lead routing + UTMs. Draft link in thread.
Owen (Content): Uploaded Snowcrest_v2.docx with two pull quotes. One uses a percent; other is qualitative. Also added two short social variants.
Sam (Legal): Quick scan: cannot include the 75% number without a signed consent addendum. Recommend we swap to "meaningfully lowered inference costs" for now. Also flag: remove internal module names.
Rae (Marketing): Noted. Owen, swap the hard stat to conservative language and keep the number version in brackets if customer confirms.
Owen (Content): Done. Now reads: "meaningfully lowered inference costs and improved tail latency." Kept number in [] as alt.
Toni (PR): We're planning press + social on 2024-03-04 09:00 PT embargo lift. launch-bot, set embargo 2024-03-04T16:00:00Z.
launch-bot: Embargo set for 2024-03-04T16:00:00Z. Reminders scheduled 24h and 1h prior.
Priya (Sales): For routing: AE-West for NA, AE-EMEA for EU, Partner-ops for strategic accounts. UTMs please: campaign=snowcrest_launch, source=social/email, medium=cta. Add lead tag: case-study-interest. I want webhook payload example.
Owen (Content): Sample payload: email: lead@example.com, campaign: snowcrest_launch, region: us, tags: [case-study-interest]
Sam (Legal): Sent legal_redlines_snowcrest.pdf. We'll accept conservative phrasing now; if customer signs addendum later we can append the stat. Also requested signed product-name consent.
Rae (Marketing): I just emailed Snowcrest legal for consent form and product-name approval. Scheduling 15-min signoff tomorrow 8:00 PT.
Priya (Sales): I'll prep the AE rotation and Slack alert template for the webhook. Ping me when the landing page URL is live.
Toni (PR): Once legal clears, I'll queue the post and run the press list. Also leaving room in social copy for a second short quote if they can provide latency impact.
Owen (Content): Sent a short ask to Snowcrest: one-sentence latency line, optional numeric. Provided a quick template to speed reply.
Rae (Marketing): Plan B: if consent not returned by EOD Friday, publish with conservative phrasing and still run webinar. Follow-ups: (1) Sam to confirm when legal fully clears, (2) Snowcrest reply, (3) Priya AE routing ready, (4) Toni press queue. Back here after signoff call. :rocket:
